يستغبون (form X)
# يَسْتَغْبُونَ (yastaḡbūna) /jas.taɣ.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
# يُسْتَغْبَوْنَ (yustaḡbawna) /jus.taɣ.baw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَغْبَى (istaḡbā)
